title: Character n-grams by Hand
learning_objectives: Extract character n-grams with boundary markers
entry_point: char_ngrams(word, n_min=3, n_max=3); jaccard(a, b, n=3)
hints: For each n in range(n_min, n_max + 1): `[s[i:i+n] for i in range(len(s) - n + 1)]`.
Sets: `A = set(char_ngrams(a, n, n))`; return `len(A & B) / len(A | B)`.

failure_feedback.advice: Wrap the word in '<' and '>' before slicing.
Order by n first, then by position.
Use sets of n-grams: |A ∩ B| / |A ∪ B|.
Return 1.0 when both n-gram sets are empty.
